2136. Addition of Two Matrices

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Read two matrices of the same size M x N and print their sum, using nested loops.

Description
Read two integers M and N representing the number of rows and columns. Read the first matrix of size M x N into a two-dimensional array, then read the second matrix of the same size into another two-dimensional array. Use nested loops to add the corresponding elements of the two matrices into a result matrix, and print the result matrix row by row.
input_spec: Two integers M and N, followed by the M x N elements of the first matrix, followed by the M x N elements of the second matrix, all given row by row.
output_spec: Print the resulting sum matrix, with M rows and N columns, each row's values separated by spaces.
